description.value: Tamm Mexican Restaurant is a family-run eatery founded in 2009 by the Tarin family, who relocated from Chihuahua, Mexico to share authentic regional cooking with Kelowna. The menu spans classic dishes like enchiladas, Chiles Rellenos, fish tacos, tortilla soup, and a wide taco selection, alongside a Latin Market stocking Mexican beverages and pantry items. Touring cyclists will find a full sit-down dining experience with online ordering and family-sized packages available.
